_sunset._note: Oyatie-doctrine is the workspace-wide principle spec — it does NOT itself sunset on a calendar; individual principles evolve through ADR amendments. Schema present to satisfy ADR-0108 baseline; the in-spec references to `sunset date` and `sunset clause` belong to principle P6 (no-silent-regression — REQUIRES sunset on breaking change) and to extension-rationale enumeration, not to this spec's own lifecycle.

title: OyatieDoctrine
description: Workspace-wide principles. Indexed by id (P0..P16). Cited by every spec / ADR / standard. Slimmed per P16 (target <= 300 lines); narrative lives in docs/standards/oyatie-doctrine.md (gateway).

_meta.applies_to: every artifact in the workspace; no exemptions without ADR-tracked carve-out
_meta.purpose: Workspace-wide principles. Indexed by id (P0..P16). Cited by every spec / ADR / standard. Slimmed per P16 (target <= 300 lines); narrative lives in docs/standards/oyatie-doctrine.md (gateway).

P0_agentic_primary.title: Agentic flow is the primary development driver
P0_agentic_primary.statement: Multi-agent autonomous masterplan execution is canonical. Human dev_flow is secondary. Every doc/file/workflow is authored for AGENT consumption first.

P1_machine_optimized.title: Machine-optimized, not merely readable
P1_machine_optimized.statement: Schema-strict, indexed-by-id, lookup-efficient, narrative-pruned. Closed enums + required fields + $schema + $id on every JSON spec.

P2_programmatic_where_possible.title: Programmatic where it can be
P2_programmatic_where_possible.statement: Auto-mechanize every mechanizable step. Hand-checked items are antipatterns. Derive values from cargo metadata / git / lane output where derivable.

P3_deterministic_where_it_matters.title: Deterministic where it matters
P3_deterministic_where_it_matters.statement: Correctness / security / audit / contract-stability paths: bit-reproducible output. Cosmetic paths: optional.

P4_enforce_in_every_thing.title: Enforce in every single thing
P4_enforce_in_every_thing.statement: Applies to every change across every layer. No exemptions without ADR. Trivial changes still consume scan-rigor.

P5_iterate_until_consensus.title: Iterate until consensus (multi-LLM debate on high-stakes)
P5_iterate_until_consensus.statement: When M1/M2 fire OR F7 high/critical OR cross-microservice contract change: Round 1 → Round 2 → Synthesis until consensus_reached or escalation_to_human. max_rounds_default=4.

P6_no_silent_regression.title: No silent regression (Linus-style)
P6_no_silent_regression.statement: Public contracts MUST NOT change silently. ADR + version bump + sunset date required for breaking changes.

P7_bominal_inheritance.title: Bominal inheritance precedence
P7_bominal_inheritance.statement: Inherit Bominal ADR decisions 1:1 by default. Oyatie session decisions override only when explicit.

P8_canonical_base_plus_localization.title: Canonical base + localization-pack architecture
P8_canonical_base_plus_localization.statement: Every µservice = canonical global base + localization overlay (seam | adapter | pack). KR is pack #1.

P9_no_sprawl.title: No documentation sprawl
P9_no_sprawl.statement: Every concept has ONE canonical home. Cross-references are pointer + 1-line summary, never restatement. New top-level artifacts require ADR.

P10_concrete_naming.title: Concrete structure + naming for every durable
P10_concrete_naming.statement: Closed BNF for path + filename. Per P14 below.

P11_durables_outside_omc.title: Durables live OUTSIDE .omc/ and .omx/
P11_durables_outside_omc.statement: .omc/ + .omx/ = agent ephemeral state ONLY (session caches, scratch, handoffs). Durables → /specs/, /registry/, /evidence/, /templates/, docs/decisions/, docs/standards/.
P11_durables_outside_omc.migration_status: F-MIGRATE-DURABLES-OUT-OF-OMC; policy during migration: NO NEW durables in .omc/

P12_masterplan_pointer_shape.title: Masterplan is pointer-shaped
P12_masterplan_pointer_shape.statement: MASTERPLAN.md + masterplan.json are NAVIGATION HUBS. Per-IP / per-phase content lives in the IP/phase INDEX; masterplan cites by pointer.

P13_industry_best_practices.title: Industry / hyperscaler baseline
P13_industry_best_practices.statement: Where industry practices exist, adopt + cite; do not reinvent. Maintainable + scalable + machine-ergonomic are non-negotiable.
examples: ADR-0056 BNF v4.1 (AWS Smithy + Google Cloud Rust precedent)
M01-P14 AWS Working Backwards / Google Design Doc / Microsoft 1ES / Oracle Eng Excellence

bnf.kind: specs | registry | evidence | templates | adrs | standards | plans
bnf.semver: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (required for versioned specs; optional for immutable-by-id evidence + ADRs)

P15_rust_default_language.title: Rust is the default; exceptions need ADR
P15_rust_default_language.statement: Every new lane / service / tool / coordination primitive is Rust by default. EXPLICITLY INCLUDES rejecting shell (.sh), Node/JS/TS (.mjs/.js/.ts) as glue, Python, Ruby, Perl, awk, sed for new coordination work without ADR.

P16_optimize_storage_size.title: Optimize storage size; verbose only when unavoidable
P16_optimize_storage_size.statement: Every artifact MUST be as small as the use case allows. JSONL > JSON for streams; Parquet > JSON for large datasets; binary > text for hot wire-format. Duplicated content is banned (sprawl + storage cost).

scope_clarifications.dev_workflow_doctrine_applies: Internal development (code, specs, docs, lanes, ADRs). Primary consumer: agents. P0..P16 bind.
scope_clarifications.workflow_studio_product_inverts_P0: Workflow Studio (n8n-class hero product; per memory: feedback_workflow_studio_scope) has VISUAL SURFACE inverted: human-ergonomic-first, no-code-first, SDK as enrichment. P0 inverted only for the VISUAL UX; P1..P16 still apply to the engine + substrate + dev-of-the-product.
scope_clarifications.rule_of_thumb: Doctrine binds the DEVELOPMENT of the product. It does NOT bind what the product EXPOSES TO its end users.

consolidation_policy.single_source_of_truth: Every concept has ONE canonical artifact; everywhere else cites + 1-line summary.
consolidation_policy.narrative_in_markdown_data_in_json: Spec data → /specs/*.json (migration target: /specs/). Human narrative → docs/standards/*.md as thin gateway.

_decision_tree.5_ecosystem_required: YAML (CI/K8s) | XML (SAML/SOAP/SVG) | CSV/TSV (tabular interchange) | INI (.editorconfig/.gitconfig) | Dockerfile | .proto/.cedar/.fbs/.smithy

jsonl.use_when: append-only event streams; independent per-line records; first line MAY be _meta

yaml.use_when: ecosystem-required (CI / K8s / OpenAPI / Helm); multi-document streams. AVOID for new internal artifacts.

markdown.use_when: human narrative; ADRs; thin gateway docs. NEVER restate JSON spec content.

xml.use_when: SOAP / SAML / SVG / RSS / Atom / legacy ecosystem

csv_tsv.use_when: tabular BI / finance / regulatory exports. RFC 4180 dialect for CSV.

parquet.use_when: columnar / analytics / ML training / large fact tables. Snappy or zstd compression. Explicit schema.

protobuf_flatbuffers_cbor.use_when: binary wire-format for hot-path RPC / indices

first_class_durable_homes./evidence/: Per-change records + audit-chain.jsonl. /evidence/audits/ for workspace audits.

migration_2026_05_14.policy_during_migration: NO new durables in /specs / /registry / .omc/templates / .omc/evidence. New durables land in canonical homes.

agent_protocol.promotion: oya vcs done + oya vcs promote after seam lane sub-checks, provider evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain coverage pass; grit done is legacy compatibility/provenance only.

decision_log.what: P10..P16 added, format_selection_rules + repository_layout added, scope_clarifications added

doctrine slimmed per P16 storage-optimization: 598 → target <=300 lines. Verbose directive_source quotes + per-principle implications arrays + per-format rules arrays compressed. Semantic content preserved; cross-references intact.
